_comment: Which SWARM network THIS BUILD is packaged for, and the identity it is packaged under. Written by scripts/set-build-profile.js from SWARM_NETWORK_PROFILE — the same input the workflows take — so the renderer's branding, the main process's window title and electron-builder's product name, app id and version cannot disagree with each other.
_why: A build ships every network definition it carries. Until now nothing inside the
packaged wallet recorded which one it was BUILT for, so the mainnet build of
2026-09-26 called itself 'SWARM Wallet (Testnet)' 0.1.0-testnet.9 and opened on
the testnet server while carrying the real mainnet genesis. The node app hit the
same wall and solved it the same way (electron/net/build-profile.json there).
See docs/SWARM-NETWORK-PROFILES.md, 'What a build is branded as'.

swarm-testnet.description: Wallet for the SwarmTestnet network. Test coins with no value.
